elements.justification: Riding is read through the device's controlled motion: a device ridden moves, so the duty is that the device be at rest (drv.motion.complete_halt: 'The road user is at rest at the observation ... its speed (kin.speed) at or below a tolerance'), as the mapping index reads 'shall be ridden' (LVMC_11_38_030).

Each term is a defined word admitted as its aggregate, never expanded into a class list (DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle 'a device propelled by human power upon which a person may ride'; DEF-LVMC-11-02-082::electric_bicycle 'a device upon which a person may ride ... an electric motor which produces not more than seven hundred fifty watts'; DEF-LVMC-11-02-083::electric_scooter 'a device with handlebars and an electric motor ... must not weigh more than one hundred pounds without a rider and must have a maximum speed of not more than twenty miles per hour ... does not include a scooter that is designed ... primarily as an assistive device'); the subject belongs to one of them. Membership is decided by the run's reading of each definition under the ru.aggregate contract: where the reading leaves a class unresolved (as it does for the electric scooter, whose weight, design maximum speed and assistive purpose no atom observes), membership is unknown and the rule reports unknown for that device, never compliance or violation; the definition's limits are not dropped by substituting the class atom ru.electric_scooter, whose contract ('a standing or seated electric scooter with handlebars') states none of them.

st.sidewalk: 'area for pedestrians between roadway and property line' (DEF-NRS-484A-240 'that portion of a highway between the curb lines ... and the adjacent property lines intended for the use of pedestrians'); rel.occupies: 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region' anchors the subject on it. Same atoms as the mapping index's 'upon any sidewalk'.

assumptions.meaning: the place of the road user at the observation lies on Fremont Street between Main Street and Seventh Street, as the map's reading records the named way and its limits

residues.why: The sentence directs the City to post signs; the riding prohibition of the first sentence holds whether or not the signs are posted, so the duty is the same either way.

applicability: The subject is a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter, each as its admitted aggregate under the run's reading, that occupies an st.sidewalk region (rel.occupies) at a place where asm.fremont_street_main_to_seventh holds.
obligation: At each such observation the subject is at rest: drv.motion.complete_halt(subject; p.halt_speed_tolerance).

narrowings.why: 'any person to ride' is read through the device's controlled motion: a device moving on the sidewalk is read as ridden, so a device pushed by a person walking beside it is not told apart from one ridden (no rider posture is read).

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle moves along a sidewalk at a place the map's reading declares to be Fremont Street between Main Street and Seventh Street.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle stands at rest on that sidewalk.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle rides on the roadway of Fremont Street within the declared stretch, never on the sidewalk.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle on that sidewalk whose speed the source does not supply.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle rides on a sidewalk at a place the map's reading declares outside the named stretch.
